recommended_title: What Can Curiosity Build? | 9 Projects to Explore
description:
A chess game with comeback rules. A ride built from formulas. A gallery made from our art.

Explore nine Lucas Academy projects, from a simple idea and a glimpse of the building process to something we can play, explore, or create with—from art and living skies to puzzles, coding competitions, and Bible games.

What are you curious about?
What will you build?
Where will you make a difference?

Explore the projects
Inception Space: https://is.lucasacademy.org
Bible Sequence: https://bible.lucasacademy.org
Painterly Chameleon: https://pc.lucasacademy.org
Lucas Academy: https://lucasacademy.org

Chapters
0:00 Balanced Chess
0:38 Bible Sequence / Next Word
1:09 Van Gogh House
1:36 Journey of Art
2:03 The Sky / Cosmic Cliffs
2:36 Painterly Chameleon / Hide-and-Seek
2:55 The Cube / 7×7 and 11×11
3:22 Coder Arena / Monthly Ranking
3:49 A Ride from Formulas
4:25 What are you curious about?

About the film
No narration; English onscreen text, with optional Chinese label subtitles.
Demos: recordings of the actual projects. Monthly Ranking uses an archived server battle.
Build sequences are concept visualizations. Gallery/cube concept sketches and the thumbnail were made with ImageGen.
Sky image: NASA/ESA/CSA/STScI — Cosmic Cliffs.
By Lucas Academy Team

Music and recording credits
1. Balanced Chess / opening: Chopin — Prelude in D-flat major, Op. 28 No. 15, Raindrop. Jeannette Fang. Musopen CC0 1.0.
https://archive.org/details/musopen-chopin-complete-works-flac

2. Bible Sequence: Debussy — Clair de lune. Laurens Goedhart, piano, 2011. Creative Commons Attribution 3.0.
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Clair_de_lune_(Claude_Debussy)_Suite_bergamasque.ogg
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
Changes: excerpt, level adjustment, and fades.

3. Van Gogh / Journey of Art: Chopin — Nocturne in E-flat major, Op. 9 No. 2. Musopen CC0 recording, same recording as the earlier Lucas Academy film.
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Chopin_-_Nocturne_No._2_in_E-flat_major,_Op._9_No._2_(Frank_Levy).flac

4. The Sky: Bach — Air from Orchestral Suite No. 3, BWV 1068, Air on the G String. Air Force Strings, United States Air Force Band, 2000. Public-domain recording.
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Air_-_Air_Force_Strings_-_United_States_Air_Force_Band.mp3

5. Hide-and-Seek / Cube / Coder Arena / roller coaster / ending: Mozart — The Marriage of Figaro, K. 492: Overture. Musopen Symphony, 2012. Public-domain recording.
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mozart_-_Le_nozze_di_Figaro,_K492_-_Overture_(Musopen_Symphony).flac
